notes: the report is Sufyan's account of Umar asking Amr about the hadith of Ata', so the chain is written to Amr, the one asked
Amr's answer «عمن هو قال عن ابن عباس» names Ibn Abbas as the source of the saying, and a later objection «فإنه حدثناه عن جابر» names Jabir: both left out pending a ruling on who transmits the saying
